_about: Public-domain Richard Lucas (1648-1715), prebendary of Westminster, for the Word Hoard: An Enquiry after Happiness (London 1764, two volumes), Religious Perfection (1749) and Twelve Sermons (1699), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 45 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
